eotwash_finite_range_indicator.validity: Schlamminger et al. 2008 (arXiv:0712.0607, verified) report equivalence-principle limits for ranges from 1 m to infinity; a torsion balance senses the horizontal part of the field, set by local topography for lambda << R_E, so this smooth-Earth vertical indicator is an order-of-magnitude guide, not a bound, and says nothing below 1 m

v2.isl_lit: [LIT] Lee, Adelberger, Cook, Fleischer & Heckel 2020, PRL 124, 101101 (arXiv:2002.11761, verified 2026-10-10): any gravitational-strength (|alpha| = 1) Yukawa is limited to ranges < 38.6 um (95 %). Every option with a mass response predicts a near-universal Yukawa of strength alpha^2 = 0.16-0.31 (0.46 in the observed-xi reading); the limit for that strength is not read off the published curve here.

ghost_onset.formula: sigma's kinetic energy around a constant sigma0 is (M/2) K sigma_t^2 with K = kappa + 6 zeta^2/F0 (F = 1 + 2 zeta sigma) or kappa + 6 zeta^2 F0 (F = exp(2 zeta sigma)) [C3]; ghost iff K < 0

prereg_notes.P5: prereg.json printed +0.911 for the ghost gamma - 1, from alpha^2 rounded to 0.313; the exact alpha^2 = 0.31336 gives +0.9127. The pass criterion is the symbolic identity B3, so P5 passes; the printed expectation was a rounding, recorded here, not moved.
prereg_notes.P6: B5/B6 hold for any sigma amplitude (B5B6_tautology_demo): P6 is true by construction at fixed bare xi_eff. Against observed potentials the composition coefficients carry 1/(1 + alpha^2), which depends on kappa and zeta; P6's 'no action choice moves them' holds exactly only at fixed observed amplitude.
prereg_notes.P8_D2: D2 (flat = covariant at quadratic order) is a tautology; it covers linear-order bounds only.
prereg_notes.E2: E2 uses the T = 0 relation P = n d eps/dn - eps.
prereg_notes.P1_local: P1 (ghost iff kappa + 6 zeta^2 < 0) is the criterion at sigma = 0; around a background sigma0 it becomes K(sigma0) < 0 (C3).
